gap: Price per trip or per person not stated
blurb: Three Sons IV Charters offers offshore and inshore fishing trips with experienced USCG licensed captains. Trips range from 2 hours to overnight, targeting various fish species depending on trip length. The boat is equipped with modern electronics, satellite TV, air conditioning, and restrooms.
extraNote: $200 deposit by credit card required upon booking · Deposit refundable only due to bad weather on day of trip · Cancellations or no-shows within 24 hrs forfeit deposit and remaining balance charged · Biloxi Small Craft Harbor, slip 25
